products.title: Products sold
products.description: Each product's quantity, takings, cost and profit, ranked your way.

staff.description: How many sales each person made and how much they took.

stockOnHand.title: Stock on hand
stockOnHand.description: Every product's quantity and value at cost and at selling price, with what is running low.
